6816.d: Pilvise taeva, kauge maastiku taustal noore naise portree poolpöördes vasakule, pea veidi kallutatud, pööratud vaatajale. Roosapõskset näoovaali ümbritseb keskelt lahkukammitud poolpikk lokiline soeng. Naisel suured tumedad silmad, malbe ilme. Seljas avara dekoltee ja puhvvarrukatega valge kelit, kolm rida pärleid kaelas. Paremal õlal ja ümber keha rohekas sall ehisnõelaga kinnitatud.
6816.de: Portrait of a young woman in half-turn to the left, against the background of a cloudy sky and a distant landscape, head slightly tilted, turned towards the viewer. The rosy-cheeked oval face is framed by a shoulder-length curly hairstyle parted in the middle. The woman has large dark eyes and a gentle expression. She is wearing a white gown with a wide décolletage and puffed sleeves, three rows of pearls around her neck. On the right shoulder and around the body a greenish scarf fastened with a decorative pin.

7235.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud kallaste vahel veekogu. Taga punetava õhtutaeva taustal antiiksete sammastemplite varemed.
7235.de: In the foreground a body of water between overgrown banks. Behind, against a reddening evening sky, the ruins of antique columned temples.

7644.d: Esiplaanil paremalt vasakule langeval nõlvakul üksikud männid, orus okaspuumets ja kaks järvepeeglit, horisonti palistab metsaveerg.
7644.de: In the foreground, on a slope descending from right to left, isolated pine trees, in the valley a coniferous forest and two lake mirrors, the horizon bordered by the edge of the forest.

7849.d: Topograafiliselt kaunis, üksikasjalikult esitatud Narva jõe vaade kahe kindlusega teine teisel pool jõge. Esiplaanil viiest mehest ja väikesest valgesse rõivastatud tüdrukust koosnev figuuridegrupp. Jõe kaldal esiplaanil puumaju, aedikuid, loomi ja põõsaid. Vasakul ja paremal servas puudegrupid. Silmaüiiril, kindlusehitustest vasakul ja paremal, laialipillatult maastikus väikesi maju. Ülal sinine, hallides pilveviirgudes ja valgetes pilvekuhilates taevas.
7849.de: A topographically beautiful, detailed view of the Narva river with two fortresses, one on each side of the river. In the foreground a group of figures consisting of five men and a small girl dressed in white. On the riverbank in the foreground, wooden houses, enclosures, animals and bushes. Groups of trees on the left and right edges. On the skyline, to the left and right of the fortress buildings, small houses scattered in the landscape. Above, a blue sky with grey cloud streaks and white cloud masses.

8112.d: Musta kunstnikubaretiga vuntsidega noore mehe poolfiguur veerandpöördes
8112.de: Half-figure of a young man with a moustache and a black artist's beret, in a three-quarter turn

25497.d: Graafiline leht ajaloolise stseeniga: Preisi kuninganna Luise surivoodil. Pildi keskmes lamab ampiirstiili kuuluvas voodis kuninganna, peas valge pitstanu. Peatsis põlvitavad surija kaks poega. Luise vaatab ainiti kroonprintsi. Voodi ees toolil istub kuninganna abikaasa, kes hoiab tema kätt oma mõlema käe vahel. Voodi peatsi taga seisavad kaks kurba daami ja vanem mees. Jalutsis seisab kõrge aumärgiga? riigimees ja seljaga vaataja poole veel üks mees, kellel on kõrge torukübar kaenlas. Vasakul ees laud, millel narmastega lina, kaks lillepotti, üks neist hortensiaga. Seinal kaks maastikumaali. (eesti)
25497.de: A print with a historical scene: the Prussian Queen Luise on her deathbed. In the centre of the picture, the queen lies in an Empire-style bed, wearing a white lace cap. At the head of the bed, the dying woman's two sons kneel. Luise gazes fixedly at the crown prince. In front of the bed, on a chair, sits the queen's husband, holding her hand between both of his. Behind the head of the bed stand two sorrowful ladies and an older man. At the foot of the bed stands a statesman with a high decoration(?), and, with his back to the viewer, another man with a tall top hat under his arm. On the left in front, a table with a fringed cloth, two flowerpots, one of them with a hydrangea. On the wall, two landscape paintings.

25508.dm: laius: 52.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 46.0 cm (leht); laius: 55.2 cm (leht); kõrgus: 43.5 cm (plaat)
25508.d: Noore mehe rinnaportree. Keha otsevaates, nägu veerandpöördes paremale. Noormees on pikemate juuste, bakenbardide, kitsa kühmuga nina ja väikeste vurrudega. Ta kannab suurte kuldnarmastega pagunitega mundrit, mille tikitud kõrge krae alt paistab tume rätik. Kaelas paelte otsas kaks ordenit, neist üks on Püha Georgi rist. Neist vasakul üleni vääriskividega kaetud orden. Paremal pool rinnas medalid: esimene за въру і въркость, teine за службу и храбростъ.(eesti)
25508.de: Bust portrait of a young man. Body in frontal view, face in three-quarter turn to the right. The young man has longer hair, sideburns, a nose with a narrow hump, and a small moustache. He wears a uniform with large gold-fringed epaulettes, from under whose embroidered high collar a dark scarf is visible. On the neck, on ribbons, two orders, one of which is the Cross of St. George. To their left an order entirely covered with precious stones. On the right side of the chest medals: the first за въру і въркость, the second за службу и храбростъ.

64845.d: Sõle servas kuppude rida ja äärevits, vits ümbritseb ka sõlesuud. Kuhikule on graveeritud kolm sõõriga ümbritsetud lilleõit.

64868.d: Ümara sileda toosi kaanel on reljeefne kiirtepärg.

64912.d: Kannu kerele on graveeritud ülaserva looklevat profiili järgiv ornamendiriba taimemotiivide ja diagonaalsete lintidega, riba keskel (tila all) asub kilp initsiaalidega HM. Sangal kerkib kahe taimelehe vahelt välja kotka või greifi pea.
64912.de: On the body of the jug an ornamental band following the undulating profile of the upper edge is engraved with plant motifs and diagonal ribbons, in the middle of the band (below the spout) is a shield with the initials HM. From the handle, between two plant leaves, rises the head of an eagle or griffin.

64917.d: Kaanega toos toetub kõrgele jalale. Kaanenupuks on ovaalsel platvormil lamav ümarplastiline lõvi, sangade ülaosas „egiptusepärased” laialisirutatud tiibadega kotkabüstid. Jala ja kaane allosa ümbritsevad stiliseeritud viinapuulehed, toosi keskel kitsas riba taimornamendiga. Kaane serva sees ava lusika jaoks.
64917.de: A lidded box resting on a high foot. The lid knob is a rounded lion figure lying on an oval platform, on the upper part of the handles "Egyptian-style" eagle busts with outstretched wings. Stylised vine leaves surround the foot and the lower part of the lid, a narrow band with plant ornament in the centre of the box. Inside the edge of the lid an opening for a spoon.

64923.d: Kannu ülemisele poolele on graveeritud ornamendiriba, kus diagonaalsed lindid vahelduvad stiliseeritud lehtornamendiga. Kannu allosal graveeritud kolmnurkadest ja sõõridega lõppevatest püstjoontest koosnev ornament. Sanga ülaosas kerkib kahe lehe vahelt välja ümarplastiline kotka- või greifipea. Madal baas rõõnestatud.
64923.de: On the upper part of the jug an ornamental band is engraved, in which diagonal ribbons alternate with stylised leaf ornament. On the lower part of the jug an ornament engraved, consisting of triangles and vertical lines ending in circles. At the top of the handle, a rounded, three-dimensional eagle's or griffin's head rises from between two leaves. The low base is fluted.

64924.d: Kannu tila on kujundatud kotka või greifina, noka vahel valamistoru. Kaanenupuks laiali sirutatud tiibadega kotkafiguur, jalge all graveeritud õis. Kannu serv ja baas rõõnestatud. Kere ülaosale on graveeritud ornamendiriba, kus diagonaalsed lindid vahelduvad stiliseeritud lehtornamendiga, riba keskel tühjaks jäetud kilp. Kere allosas graveeritud kolmnurkadest ja sõõridega lõppevatest püstjoontest koosnev ornament. Sang mustaks värvitud puidust, sanga ülemise otsa all on kerele kinnitatud reljeefne merikarbi kujutis.
64924.de: The spout of the jug is shaped as an eagle or griffin, with a pouring tube between its beak. The lid knob is an eagle figure with outstretched wings, an engraved flower beneath its feet. The rim and base of the jug are beaded. The upper part of the body is engraved with a band of ornament, in which diagonal ribbons alternate with stylised leaf ornament, with a blank shield in the middle of the band. On the lower part of the body is an engraved ornament consisting of triangles and vertical lines ending in circles. The handle is of wood painted black; below the upper end of the handle a relief depiction of a sea shell is attached to the body.

65029.d: Korv ja jalg on kaunistatud rõõnetega, korvi ümbritseb lai ažuursete rombidega serv. Ažuursel sangal stiliseeritud õiemotiivid.

65039.d: Ovaalse toosi ülaservas kitsas ornamendiriba stiliseeritud lehtedega. Sangadeks lõvimaskaroonid, mille lõugade vahel on rõngas. Võrdlemisi kõrge ovaalne jalg toetub rombikujulisele baasile. Jala serva ümbritseb reljeefsetest loorberilehtedest pärg. Tüvese krae ja kaane võlvuv keskosa on kaetud rõõnetega. Kaane nupuks on ümarplastiline stiliseeritud käbi.
65039.de: In the upper edge of the oval box a narrow ornamental strip with stylised leaves. The handles are lion masks, with a ring between their jaws. A relatively high oval foot rests on a rhombus-shaped base. The edge of the foot is surrounded by a wreath of relief laurel leaves. The collar of the stem and the vaulting central part of the lid are covered with fluting. The knob of the lid is a rounded, plastically formed stylised pine cone.

65301.dm: lehe kõrgus: 57.0 cm; kujutise laius: 36.5 cm; kujutise laius: 45.5 cm; lehe laius: 48.8 cm
65301.d: Carl Sigismund Walther oli esimene lito viljeleja Eestis ja „Kristuse pea okaskroonis“ Guido Reni järgi aastast 1818 on esimene Eestis trükitud lito. Seda on teada vaid kaks eksemplari: käesolev, mis kuulus kunagi Waltheri pojatütre Lilly Waltheri kogusse ning Tartu Ülikooli raamatukogu oma.
65301.de: Carl Sigismund Walther was the first practitioner of lithography in Estonia, and "Christ's Head in the Crown of Thorns" after Guido Reni, from 1818, is the first lithograph printed in Estonia. Only two copies are known: the present one, which once belonged to the collection of Walther's granddaughter Lilly Walther, and one held by the Tartu University Library.
